Game Overview

At its heart, World Cup Eye Art is a makeup game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in World Cup Eye Art is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is World Cup Eye Art?

World Cup Eye Art is a free makeup game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is World Cup Eye Art free to play?

Yes, World Cup Eye Art is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
